AI Sales Closing & Offer Generator – Initial Release

- Generates closing messages, objection handling responses, pricing strategies, offer structures, and upsell scripts tailored to your product, customer, and sales scenario.
- Offers tone presets: Confident/Direct, Warm/Consultative, Logical/ROI, and Urgency/Scarcity.
- Collects all required deal info in a single step for streamlined prompts.
- Provides actionable, human-sounding copy for each sales stage including closing, objection handling, pricing framing, offer creation, and upsell opportunities.
- Includes detailed guidance on triggering, inputs, and example outputs for ease of use.
